title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 110
paragraphs: With these words Miltiades won Callimachus over, and with the polemarch's vote added, the decision was taken to fight. After this, the generals who had voted for battle, as each one's day of command came round, handed over their command to Miltiades; and he accepted it, but would not yet bring on a battle — not until his own day of command arrived.
